shortDescription: Create or destroy a IONOS CLOUD Application Loadbalancer.

options.name: application_load_balancer
options.description: The ID or name of the Application Loadbalancer.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The ID or name of the datacenter.

options.name: ips
options.description: Collection of the Application Load Balancer IP addresses. (Inbound and outbound) IPs of the 'listenerLan' are customer-reserved public IPs for the public load balancers, and private IPs for the private load balancers.

options.name: lb_private_ips
options.description: Collection of private IP addresses with the subnet mask of the Application Load Balancer. IPs must contain valid a subnet mask. If no IP is provided, the system will generate an IP with /24 subnet.

options.name: listener_lan
options.description: The ID of the listening (inbound) LAN.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: target_lan
options.description: The ID of the balanced private target LAN (outbound).

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
